season.name: Winter
season.line: The dark season is holy ground.

movement.name: The Hidden Seed
movement.line: What looks dormant is being kept.

x: Thou hast turned my mourning into joy for me: thou hast rent off my sackcloth, and girded me with gladness;
that my glory may sing praise to thee, and I may not be pierced [with sorrow]. O Lord my God, I will give thanks to thee for ever.

days.t: Satisfied in the morning with your mercy
x: We have been satisfied in the morning with thy mercy; and we did exult and rejoice:

days.t: Your light shall break forth like the dawn
x: Then shall thy light break forth as the morning, and thy health shall speedily spring forth: and thy righteousness shall go before thee, and the glory of God shall compass thee.

days.t: The sun of righteousness shall arise
x: But to you that fear my name shall the Sun of righteousness arise, and healing [shall be] in his wings: and ye shall go forth, and bound as young calves let loose from bonds.

days.t: Very early, when the sun had risen
x: And very early on the first of the Sabbaths, they come to the tomb [at] the sun having arisen.

And there will be no night any longer, and they have no need of the light of a lamp and of the light of the sun, because the Lord God will illuminate upon them, and they will reign to the ages of the ages.
